name: simple-tree
description: Monopodial tree with a central leader and golden-angle laterals.
rules: A(l,w) : l > minLength -> F(l,w) [ &(trunkAngle) B(l*fork, w*taper) ] /(divergence) A(l*extend, w*taper)
B(l,w) : l > minLength -> F(l,w) [ -(branchAngle) $ C(l*fork, w*taper) ] C(l*extend, w*taper)
C(l,w) : l > minLength -> F(l,w) [ +(branchAngle) $ B(l*fork, w*taper) ] B(l*extend, w*taper)
